berlin-motorcycle-escapes-dahme-heidesee.speedBand: 50–80 km/h riding core, local limits always win

sections.advice: Treat High point near Neuruppin → Food stop near Sandau as bend craft. Brake early, look high through the turn, and keep throttle changes gentle. It is more satisfying to link ten clean bends than rescue one silly one.

Food stop near Sandau → Trossin, on the way back is the logistics leg. Watch junctions, villages and speed changes, then let the roadbook do its job: move you out of the clutter without spending your best attention too early.

Scenic stretch in Golßen → Photo stop near Lieberose is the reward section in Berlin motorcycle escapes. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
Photo stop near Lieberose → Hermsdorf is shade riding: beautiful, cooler and sometimes slick. Expect damp patches, leaves, gravel and wildlife where the trees meet the road.

places-littoral-de-chens-sur-leman-baie-.story: A 215 km round trip from Chens-sur-Léman - roughly 3 h 42 in the saddle. It goes by way of Stations de Morges, Lavaux, Baie de Clendy and back through Lavaux. The highest point is about 1,150 m. It crosses from France into Switzerland - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
